r = gf.Component()

# 1. Instantiate components with settings
mmi_splitter = r.add_ref(gf.components.mmi1x2())
mmi_splitter.move((0, 0))

phase_shifter1 = r.add_ref(gf.components.straight_heater_metal(length=10))
phase_shifter1.move((100, 50))

phase_shifter2 = r.add_ref(gf.components.straight_heater_metal(length=10))
phase_shifter2.move((100, -50))

mmi_combiner = r.add_ref(gf.components.mmi1x2())
mmi_combiner.mirror()
mmi_combiner.move((250, 0))

# 2. Route connections
gf.routing.route_single(
    r,
    mmi_splitter.ports['o2'],
    phase_shifter1.ports['o1'],
    cross_section='strip',
    radius=15
)

gf.routing.route_single(
    r,
    mmi_splitter.ports['o3'],
    phase_shifter2.ports['o1'],
    cross_section='strip',
    radius=15
)

    r,
    phase_shifter1.ports['o2'],
    mmi_combiner.ports['o2'],
    cross_section='strip',
    radius=15
)

    r,
    phase_shifter2.ports['o2'],
    mmi_combiner.ports['o1'],
    cross_section='strip',
    radius=15
)

# 4. Finalize
r.draw_ports()
